vote.question: FUTARCHY CONDITIONAL RESOLUTION [US-LA U.S. Senate]: Julia Letlow (R) has accumulated $14,603,419 in career FEC-reported receipts (anchored this cycle by Elon Musk ($168,000,000) and $373,407,000 from top-5 patrons)—out-raising general opponent Jamie Davis ($5,019,888) by 2.91x—exhibiting the "Private Equity, Speculative Finance & Real Estate Syndicate" profile. Will independent constituent & oracle review confirm that this private-interest capital concentration compromises public representation in US-LA, thereby executing the LA Corrective Restitution Pool toward affordable housing trusts, predatory-lending legal aid, and household debt relief?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Private campaign financing treats US-LA representation as an investable asset class. When Julia Letlow's campaign apparatus absorbs $14,603,419 (anchored this cycle by Elon Musk ($168,000,000) and $373,407,000 from top-5 patrons), policy incentives skew toward housing financialization, consumer debt deregulation, and tax-code arbitrage. This futarchy market converts spectator outrage into direct fiscal counter-leverage.
